# VIPER: recall decisions against cancer (generated by scripts/viper_recall_vs_cancer.py)

Each read has a recall decision (send for further work-up or not) and the gold label is cancer status at 455-day follow-up. Non-cancer cases carry their outcome in the original screening (`Ctype`): BI-RADS 0 means recalled for further imaging, BI-RADS 1-3 means not recalled. Sensitivity = share of cancer reads recalled; specificity = share of non-cancer reads not recalled; skill (Youden J) = sensitivity + specificity - 1.

## FFDM

712 cases (115 cancers), 43 readers, 67% missing.

### 1. Cancers that were not recalled

| | Value |
|---|---:|
| Cancer reads not recalled | 712 of 2590 (27%) |
| Cancer cases recalled by fewer than half their readers | 26 of 115 |
| Cancer cases recalled by no reader | 0 (each is read by 10-25 readers) |
| Cancer cases recalled by every reader | 28 |
| Per-reader sensitivity, median [range] | 73% [46%-96%] |
| Per-reader specificity, median [range] | 52% [14%-78%] |

### 2. Recall rate by the case's original screening outcome

| Case type | Cases | Reads | Recall rate | Per-reader recall rate, median [range] |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| No cancer, recalled in original screening (BI-RADS 0) | 315 | 2788 | 60% | 62% [24%-94%] |
| No cancer, not recalled (BI-RADS 1-3) | 282 | 4805 | 38% | 35% [13%-86%] |
| Cancer | 115 | 2590 | 73% | 73% [46%-96%] |

### 3. Do Dawid-Skene and FUSE, without labels, rank the readers correctly?

Spearman correlation across readers between each method's estimate (fitted on recall decisions only) and the true value. 'Recall rate' is shown because it drives both sensitivity and specificity.

| Full matrix (all readers) | Dawid-Skene | FUSE (missing-aware MoM) | Recall rate alone |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Estimated vs true sensitivity | +0.86 | +0.85 | +0.87 |
| Estimated vs true specificity | +0.96 | +0.97 | -0.96 |
| Estimated vs true skill (J) | +0.53 | +0.59 | -0.53 |
| Estimated skill vs recall rate | -0.46 | -0.55 | |

FUSE mean estimated sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.67.

Dawid-Skene mean estimated vs true: sensitivity 0.81 vs 0.72, specificity 0.68 vs 0.51. D&S posterior AUC against cancer: 0.744. Readers read 17-79 cancer cases each.
